sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r2/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 23 = check 22; Internal Quality Checks row 23, no extra annotation cells or comments; Deterministic Checks rows for check-dockerfiles.py, check-runtime-deps-in-both-images.py, check-verifier-tooling-baked.sh)
evidence: Source conformance (static, not a build): task/tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template tests/Dockerfile (cmp; sha256 72998ab8...a55fdd), as are test.sh, .dockerignore, tools/score.py, tools/restart_mcp.py and environment/Dockerfile. tests/Dockerfile:16-22 installs the judge CLI @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281 (matches task.toml:31 REWARDKIT_JUDGE=claude-code), @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1; :31 pins harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7; :33-39 installs Chromium through the Playwright CLI bundled with the pinned MCP package into /opt/playwright-browsers and symlinks /usr/local/bin/chromium, which is exactly the --executable-path every one of the five judge.toml files passes to playwright-mcp (line 12 of each). :2 python:3.12-slim supplies /usr/local/bin/python3 used by scored/functional/judge.toml:17 for restart_mcp.py and by test.sh probes; :1,:4 copy Node 22 from node:22-bookworm-slim; :12-14 adds procps and util-linux (setsid/setpriv used at test.sh:104-111) plus fonts; :43 COPY . /tests. App runtime: solution/app/server.js:2-5 requires only node built-ins, express and better-sqlite3, resolved via NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules (Dockerfile:9, test.sh:106); both are the same versions as environment/Dockerfile:9-11, so check-runtime-deps-in-both-images holds by manual application. The other package.json dependencies (react, prettier, acorn, @lezer/html) are build-time inputs bundled into public/assets/index.js, served statically (server.js:130-131); public/index.html references only same-origin /assets files, and solve.sh:38 copies the prebuilt app with no install step. Weak-app probe: an app that needs an npm module absent from the verifier image fails liveness and scores 0 - correct, since the agent image offers the same two modules. Conforming-alternative probe: an agent that vendors extra modules into /app/node_modules still starts because test.sh:72-83 allows in-tree node_modules links and Node resolves local modules first. Limits: base tags node:22-bookworm-slim and python:3.12-slim and the apt packages are floating (template-controlled; the deterministic rule treats unpinned apt as a NOTE), and the Chromium build is pinned only transitively through @playwright/mcp@0.0.79. MISSING MEASUREMENT: raw-evidence-index.json covers scripted golden behaviour only and states 'Not a configured LLM judge run'; no hash-bound record shows this verifier image built, the app launched under test.sh, or rewardkit graded. The Dockerfile:41 assert-and-patch of rewardkit/agents.py and the Playwright browser download can only be confirmed by an actual build. qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md requires a full verifier launch/grading runtime record before local clearance, so risk stays true.
suggested_fix: No task edit. Owner should build tests/Dockerfile for this input hash and record a hash-bound full verifier launch (image build log, app liveness, rewardkit gates+scored run) before clearance; do not alter the template-controlled Dockerfile.
